title: Warm shade: the fills and the ground bounce stop tinting every shadow cyan-green
why: Survey 2026-09-16: every city street reads slate-blue and gritty, while the SAME cobble in sunlight reads cream. The shade is lit by an unshadowed ground bounce tinted cyan (214,244,238), a canopy fill tinted green (220,236,214), and a sky light with a black lower hemisphere. A bounce off pale cream paving is warm. First try (fills + ground bounce only) barely moved the frames: the fills are ~13% of the sun. The dominant shade colour is the SKY LIGHT capturing a sky LOOK01 deliberately boosted toward blue (sky_luminance_factor 1.2/1.4/1.85). Tinting the sky light's own colour warms the ambient it contributes without changing the blue sky the visitor sees. Third try, (255,222,190) on the sky light: the blue was gone but everything went sepia and darker, and the hero corridor lost its brightness -- brown is not the Bible's pastel. The chosen values only neutralise the blue cast, and the sky light's intensity rises slightly to give back the luminance a warm tint removes.
